beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: In this town, everybody parties.
beats.visual: Crane down the party street.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Except me.
beats.visual: Marcus's window; inside he lies flat, face up, under his desk.

beats.speaker: marcus
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Marcus slides under the table flat on his back, one push per HUSS.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Grandad joined a conga line in nineteen eighty two. He's still in it.
beats.visual: A conga line snakes down the street; Grandad at the back, older than everyone, still going.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: While they're out partying, by the way, I'm practising limbo.
beats.visual: Marcus's room: a broom across two chairs; he slides under it.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I sleep under my bed. I go under doors.
beats.visual: Under the bed (only his shoes stick out); then sliding under the bedroom door gap.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: How low can you go? Lower. A worm.

card.quote: How low can you go? Lower.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD; attribution on 'A worm.'

beats.speaker: marcus
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Under a chair, under the cat, under the pigeon.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then came the Summer Party Limbo Championship.
beats.visual: Square: banner SUMMER PARTY / LIMBO / CHAMPIONSHIP; a limbo bar on the stage, a queue of dancers.

beats.speaker: mayor
beats.text: How low can you go?
beats.visual: The mayor at the bar with a microphone.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Brenda fell asleep under the bar. Disqualified for comfort.
beats.visual: Brenda lying under the bar, asleep (Zzz); red OUT stamp.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The mayor's hat hit the bar. Out.
beats.visual: The mayor limbos, his top hat knocks the bar; OUT stamp.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then it was me. And the bar. At one centimetre.
beats.visual: The bar lowered almost to the floor; tag 1 CM; Marcus lies down and stares at it.

beats.speaker: marcus
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: One push per HUSS: Marcus slides flat under the 1 cm bar; the crowd leans in.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Top ten respectful moments. Number seven: the bar bowed to me.
beats.visual: TOP 10 card; the limbo bar sags in the middle like a bow; the crowd claps.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Never look down. Unless you're already there. A submarine.

card.quote: Never look down. Unless you're already there.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD; attribution on 'A submarine.'

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I won. But I can't stand up anymore.
beats.visual: Trophy laid on his chest; he tries to sit up and can't.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Now in this town, everybody parties. Except me.
beats.visual: The street party; Marcus still flat on his back, sliding between dancers' legs.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: I live down here now.
beats.visual: Low camera at floor level: Marcus waves from the ground; the cat walks over him.

beats.speaker: marcus
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: He slides off out of frame, one push per HUSS. End.
